title: What to say when the queue estimate disappears
titleZh: 排隊等待估時不見時該怎麼說
passage: Before we practise taking calls, look at the two times on your screen. “Longest wait” tells us how long one caller has already been waiting. It’s useful to the supervisor, but it isn’t a prediction for the person who just called. Use the live estimate when it’s available. If the estimate is missing, you can still arrange a callback, but only if the caller accepts one and you can see a free slot. A full list means you should offer to keep them on the line, not invent a time. After the exercise, give me the words you used, not the number of calls you finished. I want to see whether the caller could tell what would happen next.
passageZh: 開始練習接電話前，請看螢幕上兩種時間。「最長等待時間」代表有一位來電者已經等了多久。這對主管有用，但不能用來預測剛打進來的人要等多久。 即時估時有顯示時就用它。如果沒有估時，仍可以安排回電，但要來電者接受，而且你看得到空時段。若時段全滿，應詢問對方是否願意繼續在線上等，不要編造時間。 練習後，請告訴我你用了哪些說法，不是完成了幾通電話。我想看看來電者能不能聽懂接下來會怎麼安排。
